title: Request Materialization Audit Input v0
description: Adapter-neutral batch input for auditing deterministic materialization and same-scope dedupe across validated AgentMesh request sources or retained canonical summaries.

markdown.description: Request Markdown source containing a YAML frontmatter fence. CRLF is normalized to LF before parsing and source hashing.

request.description: Validated agentmesh-request.v0 stable request fields as JSON. Adapter-specific fields may appear here but are fingerprinted outside common materialization.

canonical.description: Canonical request fields from a retained parser output.

summary.description: Retained compact summary with valid:true and canonical fields under canonical, manifest_json.canonical_fields, or evidence.frontmatter_fields.

adapter.description: Optional adapter-owned materialization metadata. Values are hashed, not echoed, in compact output.

adapter_specific.description: Optional adapter-owned details. Values are hashed, not echoed, in compact output.
